name: 89101 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89101 (Las Vegas) has 158 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89101 (Las Vegas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
59% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 89101 (Las Vegas) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 66% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
